description:
The patch now accepts any Google Maps version and finds the code it needs without relying on version-specific names. This builds on [PR #7](https://github.com/fangkampanat/gmaps-patches/pull/7) by [Harvey843](https://github.com/Harvey843), with additional checks that stop patching when required code is missing or matches are ambiguous.

You can reuse this bundle for newer Maps APKs. Each new APK still needs patching and testing; accepting any version does not guarantee that every version works.

Morphe Desktop now displays `Google Maps Morphe` and uses that name in output filenames. The installed app name and package stay the same. The patch requires MicroG-RE-BYD.

Testing covered:

- Maps `26.36.05.973607363` with the final `1.2.0` bundle passed APK signature and 16 KiB alignment checks. Phone tests passed for sign-in, online maps and real-GPS navigation. Reinstalling the same APK preserved the account and app state.
- Maps `26.29.02.946673643` and `26.37.05.977222275` beta passed phone tests with the local `1.1.2` bundle, which contains the same patch and extension code as `1.2.0`.
- Maps `26.35.04.969485213` passed static checks with `1.1.2`; it was not tested on the phone in this round.

Bundle SHA-256: `587c7efef607d6c82c154d050b9410ae38bb9e58fda4c069820197ea50bcaa73`.
